audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave K'Sante Levels 2 and 3 and called Levels 4-5 and 6 Skill, while the page's own whys[1] through whys[5] say Kled wins every one of those rows ('first real all-in window', 'wins the level-3 all-in outright', 'out-trade with remount sustain', 'guaranteed kill', 'shred his tank HP'). The packet chart reads Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/K'Sante at a 54.38% win rate.
audit.why: The prose, the packet and the win rate all agreed; only the side tokens disagreed, so the page rendered two answers to who wins Level 2.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 set to Kled as matched pairs in both layers, ratings re-scaled 5/7/8/7/7/6/4. Row 0 (Skill) and row 6 (K'Sante) left as they were — both already match the prose and the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: All Out was described only as 'his duelist mode' with no timer, and no phase row carried a cooldown.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s; Path Maker is 14/13/12/11/10s; Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5s 450-range poke; Bear Trap is free at 11s and reaches 800; CHAAAARGE is 140s. The 800-vs-450 range gap is the whole trading pattern.
audit.corrected: The 120s All Out, the 14s Path Maker and the 800/450 range gap written into the phase rows, the cooldown block and the Do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors. (a) whys[0] and early call his passive 'percent-HP passive autos' — Dauntless Instinct marks targets to take more damage on his next attack, with no percent-HP component in Riot's text. (b) wants.foe[1] says 'Land Q knockup to interrupt your E dash' — Ntofo Strikes slows, and at two stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in; the knockup/knockback belongs to Path Maker (W) and All Out (R). (c) Nothing warned that Path Maker deals true damage.
audit.why: A reader stacking armour against Path Maker gets nothing — true damage ignores resistances entirely. And expecting a knockup off Q means mistiming the actual pull.
audit.corrected: Passive re-described as marked autos; the two-stack pull named correctly; the true-damage warning written into the interactions row.
sources: kit file ksante P, Q, W
